interpretation: Of 1710 vulnerabilities CISA currently lists as actively exploited in the wild, 399 involve VPN, remote-access, or remote-gateway products — the same attack-surface category (vendor VPN) implicated in the simulated INC-VND2023 scenario and targeted by Simulation Scenario A (vendor VPN MFA, Section 6). This is live external corroboration that vendor/remote-access hardening is a currently active, real-world priority, not just a scenario assumption.
